sections.title: Data engineering decisions that matter for AI

blocks.heading: Build on what you already have
paragraphs: We build directly on your existing Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or other warehouse infrastructure rather than introducing new platforms where your current investment is sound.

blocks.heading: Is a feature store worth it?
paragraphs: If you are building one to three models with distinct feature sets, feature store overhead usually isn't justified. For four or more models sharing features — or if you have already experienced training-serving skew — a feature store pays back.

blocks.heading: dbt and Airflow are complementary
paragraphs: dbt transforms data inside your warehouse with version-controlled, tested SQL; Airflow orchestrates when and in what order pipeline tasks run. Most modern data stacks use both, and we design pipelines accordingly.

sections.title: Questions about AI data engineering services

items.question: How much does AI data engineering cost?
items.answer: $10,000–$250,000. The most common enterprise engagements — multi-source ETL with basic feature engineering and a model serving API — run $30,000–$80,000.

items.question: Can you work with our existing Snowflake or Databricks setup?
items.answer: Yes. We build directly on your existing warehouse infrastructure rather than introducing new platforms where your current investment is sound.

items.question: How long does a full MLOps platform take to build?
items.answer: 16–32 weeks for a comprehensive platform. We recommend phased delivery: experiment tracking first (6–8 weeks), then CI/CD and monitoring (an additional 8–12 weeks), then advanced features.

items.question: What maintenance do pipelines need after delivery?
items.answer: Pipeline monitoring response, schema change handling as source systems evolve, and capacity scaling as data volumes grow. Monthly support contracts are available for routine maintenance.

items.question: Can you take over an existing pipeline that isn't working?
items.answer: Yes. Pipeline audits and remediation are a specific engagement type: we diagnose what is failing and either remediate or recommend a targeted rebuild.
